lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: there's something I want to tell you.
What's wrong, Admi?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Actually...
Admi?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I've been having a lot of nightmares lately.
What kind of nightmares?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: The kind that startles me awake and not let me easily drift back into sleep.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Then, I find myself pondering why I'm having these unsettling dreams,

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: and before I know it, morning has already arrived.
Sounds rough.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I feel anxious that something bad is going to happen.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Is there anything I can do about it?
Can you tell me what the dreams are about? I can help interpret them for you.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Sure, but what good would that do?
By analyzing these nightmares, we can figure out what they mean.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: The scariest dream I've had recently

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: involved drowning.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: The water was so deep

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: that I couldn't see the bottom.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: It was absolutely frightening.
I just looked it up, and water in dreams apparently symbolizes hope.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Hope?
Yeah, and since you were drowning in really deep water, that means you'll succeed greatly.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I also dream a lot about a huge snake.
A snake symbolizes luck and vitality.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Luck and vitality, huh?
Yeah, seems like you'll lead a long and successful life.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Wow, I had no idea that's what it all meant.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I initially found it rather unsettling, but realizing there's a positive meaning behind it all

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: brings a comforting sense of clarity.
I bet!

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Actually, there's one more dream that I'm curious about.
Yeah? Tell me.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I dreamed of your back.
My back?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: But regardless of how much I call out to you, you refuse to turn around.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Do you think that's also a good dream?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I'm worried that perhaps you're not entirely comfortable talking with me.
Well, dreams and real life aren't always analogous.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Sorry?
Because I'm having a great time talking to you right now.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Ah, is that so?
Nightmares can be little hints of good things to come, so relax and get some rest.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Thank you, Commander!
